name: @jackal-alex/dsh-session-delete
description: Delete DSH sessions from the sidebar: move to a restorable trash can, or purge permanently. | 在 DSH 侧边栏删除会话：先移入可恢复的回收站，也可彻底删除。
author: jackal-Alex

scripts.check: node --check lib/host.js && node --check lib/index.js && node --check lib/client.js
scripts.test: node tests/host.test.mjs && node tests/routes.test.mjs && node tests/client.test.mjs
scripts.check:meta: node -e "const p=require('./package.json');const bad=['repository.url','homepage','bugs.url','author'].filter(k=>k.split('.').reduce((o,x)=>o&&o[x],p)?.includes?.('OWNER'));if(bad.length){console.error('替换 package.json 里的 OWNER：'+bad.join(', '));process.exit(1)}console.log('metadata ok')"
